text: The sky appears blue because of the way sunlight interacts with the atmosphere. Sunlight contains various wavelengths of light, and when it enters the Earth's atmosphere, the shorter wavelengths (blue and violet) are scattered in all directions by molecules in the air and small particles. This scattering, known as Rayleigh scattering, makes the sky appear blue.
